</role>
<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is invoice PO-number errors causing reconciliation and payment delays. I checked the most similar item, story 4130 'Payment history improvements' (completed 2026-09-15), which improves transaction tracking and categorization for faster reconciliation but does not address incorrect purchase order numbers on invoices. Story 4138 (Organisation settings) and 4134 (Task list improvements) are unrelated, and the two release notes pages cover claims processing, not invoice PO data. No completed story or roadmap item solves the same problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
